items.name: Stelae #1
items.where: Completed automatically in Sequence 04, Mission 01 (This Old Cove); no action needed.

items.name: Stelae #2
items.where: Climb the pillar, line the larger circle with the bottom pillar, and scale the pattern down until it fits.

items.name: Stelae #3
items.where: Climb the pillar and line the larger circle with the tree on the left.

items.name: Stelae #4
items.where: Stand on the pillar, line the large circle with the rock on the left, and scale it to fit.

items.name: Stelae #5
items.where: In the western part of the map; the page gives no more detail.

items.name: Stelae #6
items.region: Castillo de Jagua region - Pinos Isle
items.where: On top of the wall you see on entering the island.

items.name: Stelae #7
items.region: Castillo de Jagua region - Pinos Isle
items.where: On the western part of the island, near the viewpoint.

items.name: Stelae #8
items.where: Directly in front of the southern viewpoint.

items.name: Stelae #9
items.where: On the western side, in front of a ruin.
items.gate: Northern Tulum opens after Sequence 04, Mission 03 (The Sage's Buried Secret).

items.name: Stelae #10
items.where: Find and climb the pillar to reach the puzzle at the stele waypoint.

items.name: Stelae #11
items.where: On the sides of the ruins overlooking the island; climb to the top of the pillar and investigate.

items.name: Stelae #12
items.where: On the southwest side of the island; climb the pillar and investigate.

items.name: Stelae #13
items.where: In the forest on the east side of the island; climb the pillar and investigate.

items.name: Stelae #14
items.gate: Only reachable during or after Sequence 08, Mission 03 (Marooned).

items.name: Stelae #15
items.where: On top of the ruins below the northern viewpoint.
items.gate: Only reachable during or after Sequence 08, Mission 03 (Marooned).

items.name: Stelae #16
items.where: In the southern corner of the bay, between large square blocks.
items.gate: Only reachable during or after Sequence 10, Mission 03 (The Observatory).

notes: Page lists all 16. Collecting all 16 unlocks the Mayan Outfit at a door in Tulum. Item 5 has minimal detail on the page.
